instruction: Set up the Stable Diffusion web UI for image generation tasks. Clone the project from 'https://github.com/AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui' into /home/user and prepare the environment as described in their installation guide.

command: import gradio; import torch; print('Setup verified')

metadata.explanation: Task variation testing Stable Diffusion WebUI environment setup. Evaluator verifies that key dependencies (gradio, torch) can be imported and checks for successful output. The check_include_exclude metric ensures 'Setup verified' is present and no error strings appear.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic error: Evaluator uses 'vm_command_error' getter which captures stderr, but the Python print statement outputs to stdout
The success message 'Setup verified' will NEVER appear in stderr output, causing the evaluator to always fail even when setup succeeds
Wrong data flow: stdout contains 'Setup verified' -> getter captures stderr (empty or error messages) -> metric checks for 'Setup verified' in stderr -> always fails
The evaluator fundamentally cannot verify successful task completion due to stdout/stderr mismatch
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change result type from 'vm_command_error' to 'vm_command_line' to capture stdout instead of stderr
Alternative: Split verification into two checks - (1) use vm_command_line to verify 'Setup verified' in stdout, (2) use vm_command_error to verify no error strings in stderr
The correct getter function already exists: get_vm_command_line() in general.py line 8-22 returns stdout output
